# Provenance of the SmartPLS sample datasets

<!-- GENERATED by packages/fixtures/scripts/build_third_party.py from
     packages/fixtures/scripts/third_party_sources.json. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

Checked on 2026-11-19. Every URL below was opened on that date; nothing is asserted from memory.

The six datasets in this directory were converted from the delimited text files that the
project owner supplied in `TEMP/` (five SmartPLS 4 sample-project folders).

**The encrypted SmartPLS project files were not used.** The files `*.splsm`, `*.splscb`,
`*.splspm`, `*.splsge` and `*.splsrm` were never opened, decoded, decrypted or
reverse-engineered. Only the delimited `*.txt` data files and the plain-JSON `*.settings` /
`*.ok` side files were read. Structural paths are therefore **not** taken from SmartPLS: the
`proposed-model.json` files are SEM Lab's own specifications from the published theory.

## Status vocabulary

- `redistributable-with-attribution`: A licence was found at the source and it permits redistribution with attribution.
- `terms-unverified`: No licence or terms covering redistribution were found at the sources opened. Do not publish in a public build until the owner clears it.
- `restricted`: Terms were found and they forbid redistribution.

A status is only ever raised when a source that was actually opened supports it.

## Per dataset

### `tam` — Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) sample data

- **Status:** `terms-unverified`
- **Source file:** `TEMP/Example - TAM/Data.txt` (sha256 `1438440e7072f005f877013416af0d7a002a3940e1b1db58b950035a3033f163`)
- **Fixture:** `tam/data.csv`, 1190 rows x 22 columns (sha256 `f2faa549b62f812f672936720aecfeaf166c63b612a7488c99106ca094b97d22`)
- **Origin:** Survey of 1,190 computer users in Saudi Arabia. The SmartPLS sample-project page attributes the data to Anderson, Al-Gahtani & Hubona (2011) and says Al-Gahtani, Hubona & Wang (2007), Al-Gahtani & Shih (2009) and Anderson et al. (2011) describe the data and the model.
- **Licence / terms:** None stated. The SmartPLS sample-project page and the SmartPLS terms and conditions say nothing about reuse or redistribution of sample data. No public deposit of the item-level data with a licence was found.
- **Identity check against an independent copy:** Not possible: no independent public copy of the item-level data was found.
- **What would change the status:** Written permission from the data owners (Al-Gahtani / Hubona) or from SmartPLS GmbH, or a public deposit of the item-level data under an open licence.
- **URLs opened:**
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/documentation/sample-projects>
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/documentation/sample-projects/tam>
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/terms>
- **References:**
  - Anderson, C., Al-Gahtani, S. S., & Hubona, G. S. (2011). The value of TAM antecedents in global IS development and research. Journal of Organizational and End User Computing, 23(1), 18-37.
  - Al-Gahtani, S. S., Hubona, G. S., & Wang, J. (2007). Information technology (IT) in Saudi Arabia: Culture and the acceptance and use of IT. Information & Management, 44(8), 681-691. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.im.2007.09.002
  - Al-Gahtani, S. S., & Shih, H.-P. (2009). The influence of organizational communication openness on the post-adoption of computers. Journal of Global Information Management, 17(3), 20-41. https://doi.org/10.4018/jgim.2009070102

### `oi` — Organizational identification sample data (Bergami & Bagozzi, 2000)

- **Status:** `terms-unverified`
- **Source file:** `TEMP/Example - OI/Data.txt` (sha256 `9c93f4bde64569653f84938ebbefabfccee8695c08c9d032c97edecbcfc363a7`)
- **Fixture:** `oi/data.csv`, 305 rows x 25 columns (sha256 `eda9295b7f5df66e73400055f41d2562c2425cbc98e2d2c080be24400f2a5dde`)
- **Origin:** 305 employees, organizational identification data of Bergami & Bagozzi (2000), widely reused as the GSCA demonstration data of Hwang & Takane (2004, 2014). The SmartPLS page says the data are 'taken from U.S.'; the cSEM package documentation says 'South Korean employees'. The discrepancy is unresolved because the primary article could not be opened (HTTP 403).
- **Licence / terms:** None stated on the SmartPLS page. The same 22 variables and 305 rows are distributed on CRAN inside cSEM 0.7.1 as BergamiBagozzi2000 (package licence GPL-3) and inside gesca 1.0.5 as gesca.rick2 (package licence GPL >= 2). Neither package documents permission from the original authors.
- **Identity check against an independent copy:** Verified on 2026-11-19: the 22 non-derived columns are cell-for-cell identical, in the same row order, to cSEM 0.7.1 BergamiBagozzi2000; gesca 1.0.5 gesca.rick2 differs in exactly one cell (cei7/org_pre7). The three *_rev columns are 6 - ac_love* and exist only in the SmartPLS sample. See evidence oi-cran-comparison.json.
- **What would change the status:** Either (a) the owner accepts GPL-3 terms for this one data file and it is rebuilt from cSEM's BergamiBagozzi2000 with the GPL notice, or (b) the R engine loads cSEM::BergamiBagozzi2000 at run time so SEM Lab redistributes nothing, or (c) permission from the original authors.
- **URLs opened:**
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/documentation/sample-projects/organizational-identification>
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/documentation/sample-projects/organizational-identification-variations-pls>
  - <https://floschuberth.github.io/cSEM/reference/BergamiBagozzi2000.html>
  - <https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/cSEM/html/BergamiBagozzi2000.html>
  - <https://rdrr.io/cran/gesca/man/gesca.rick2.html>
  - <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/cSEM/index.html>
  - <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gesca/index.html>
  - <https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/cSEM_0.7.1.tar.gz>
  - <https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/gesca_1.0.5.tar.gz>
- **References:**
  - Bergami, M., & Bagozzi, R. P. (2000). Self-categorization, affective commitment and group self-esteem as distinct aspects of social identity in the organization. British Journal of Social Psychology, 39(4), 555-577. https://doi.org/10.1348/014466600164633
  - Hwang, H., & Takane, Y. (2004). Generalized structured component analysis. Psychometrika, 69(1), 81-99. https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02295841
  - Hwang, H., & Takane, Y. (2014). Generalized Structured Component Analysis: A Component-Based Approach to Structural Equation Modeling. Chapman & Hall/CRC.

### `acsi-2015` — American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI) 2015 sample data

- **Status:** `redistributable-with-attribution`
- **Source file:** `TEMP/Example - ACSI/ACSI Data 2015.txt` (sha256 `5d1adc648b8ded99dad54a76eb45e6ddaa14b1b8157bbf4343a32e2b362fc67e`)
- **Fixture:** `acsi-2015/data.csv`, 8239 rows x 29 columns (sha256 `9dd0e921ab14d054c02a7bc55f4f1ec4e8743effef7f587bc1fc9791663a1d98`)
- **Origin:** Sample of 8,239 consumer responses collected by the American Customer Satisfaction Index in 2015 for four industries, deposited by the ACSI researchers on Mendeley Data and described in a Data in Brief article (Morgeson, Hult, Sharma & Fornell, 2023).
- **Licence / terms:** CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0) as stated in the Mendeley Data record. The Data in Brief article text itself is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; that licence covers the article, not the deposited data files.
- **Identity check against an independent copy:** Verified on 2026-11-19: 'ACSI Data 2015.xlsx' of Mendeley Data version 2 (sha256 53cc5ad2cf7ce8c4b1ed214e21508b7ba5059867aaedd1d9cc28ba8fc3c9bf3f) has the same 29 columns and 8,239 rows in the same order; all 185,006 value cells are identical; the 53,925 empty fields of the SmartPLS text file correspond exactly to cells that are 98, 99, '#NULL!' or empty in the deposit. See evidence acsi-mendeley-comparison.json.
- **Required attribution:** Hult, Tomas; Morgeson, Forrest (2023), "The American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI): A Sample Dataset and Description", Mendeley Data, V2, doi: 10.17632/64xkbj2ry5.2. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changes made: converted to CSV; the missing-data codes 98 and 99, SPSS '#NULL!' cells and empty cells are written as empty fields.
- **What would change the status:** Nothing needed. Keep the attribution text and the CC BY 4.0 link wherever the file is shown or shipped.
- **URLs opened:**
  - <https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/64xkbj2ry5/2>
  - <https://data.mendeley.com/public-api/datasets/64xkbj2ry5>
  - <https://data.mendeley.com/public-files/datasets/64xkbj2ry5/files/e4e4b8b0-0d7d-41a9-a2be-c1e586897d7e/file_downloaded>
  - <https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10148075>
  - <https://www.smartpls.com/documentation/sample-projects/acsi>
- **References:**
  - Morgeson, F. V., III, Hult, G. T. M., Sharma, U., & Fornell, C. (2023). The American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI): A sample dataset and description. Data in Brief, 48, 109123. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2023.109123

## What this means for the example gallery

- May be bundled in a public build with the attribution above: `acsi-2015`.
- Keep out of public builds until the owner clears the terms: `tam`, `utaut`, `oi`, `concise-guide`, `hbat`.
  They can still be used locally as numerical fixtures.
